providers.name: Convex StakingProxyERC20 and fxSP gauge strategy

custodyProfile.uncertainty: On-chain custody is through fxSP holdings and the Convex staking/gauge strategy: SavingFxUSD.totalAssets() sums the base-token balance of the vault and gauge-token balance of its staking vault. Ethereum block 26095803 confirms asset() is fxSP and the same implementation remains active. Provider entries describe protocol custody paths, not regulated custodians. Legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness and rehypothecation safeguards are not established by this evidence.
